treaty_name: Agreement between Canada and the Republic of Turkey for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (2009, with Protocol)
eif_quote: Canada-Turkey Tax Convention Act, 2010: "[Note: Agreement and Protocol in force May 4, 2011, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 145, page 2023.]" | Treaty-accord: "Entry into Force 04 May 2011"
source_title: Canada-Turkey Tax Convention Act, 2010 (S.C. 2010, c. 15), Schedules 1-2 - Agreement and Protocol (Justice Laws consolidated text)

rates.quote: (a) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly shares representing at least 10 per cent of the voting power of the company paying the dividends,
(b) 20 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2 However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2 However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: n/a (Turkiye has not ratified the MLI)

notes: Art. 28(2)(a): effective for tax withheld at source on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (EIF 2011-05-04 -> 2012-01-01). Dividend 15% tier: company (other than a partnership) holding directly shares representing at least 10% of the voting power (voting test recorded as ownership_threshold 10). Not modelled: Art. 11(3) exemption for interest paid to the Government / Central Bank of Turkey or the Government of Canada / Bank of Canada; Art. 10(6) branch tax (Canada 15%, Turkey 20%); Protocol para. 7: Canadian tax on estate/trust income capped at 15%. Protocol para. 1 excludes low-taxed non-resident-owned entities. MLI: Turkiye has signed but not ratified the MLI - no PPT.
